note_en: 以免 (yǐmiǎn) means "so as not to" or "to avoid" and introduces the bad result you want to prevent: 不要堵住车门和过道，以免影响其他乘客上下车 "don't block the doors and aisle, so you don't get in other passengers' way." Unlike English "in case," it comes at the start of the second clause, and what follows it is the thing you're trying to avoid, not the thing that might happen anyway.
